inspectedText: Inspected original scan: married William and Ellen lived with different enslavers in Georgia. Ellen dressed as a man and passed as master; William as servant. Neither could read/write. She tied right hand as lame because hotel registers required name; report says she was asked several times. Arrival in Philadelphia after four days. Signature Wm.W.Brown and Pineville Jan4,1849. Postscript describes them hiding near Philadelphia and forthcoming lectures.
locator: PDF page3, fourth text column, lower section, Singular Escape
limitations: Information may come from the Crafts; early reporting is not independent travel corroboration.
Its assertion they were out of reach in the North is contradicted by subsequent recapture attempts.
